phase_policy.build: One complete Williams4 cycle, rotated by seed%4: [0,1,3,2],[1,2,0,3],[2,3,1,0],[3,0,2,1]
phase_policy.query: Serial/parallel alternating AB/BA, rotated by seed%2; two occurrences of each order
phase_policy.sequence: All build trials precede one canonical query bitmap; serial and parallel query warmups outside clocks

geometry_policy: Split retains real_n and uses public legacy_bpk=actual_bpk/2 at16/32; Range uses public byte budget real_n*actual_bpk/8 at16/24/32; no duplicate Split24 alias
placement: Whole node1 socket lock and explicit NUMA binding. Serial controls CPU3. Public parallel calls inherit firstT allowed physical CPUs; no individual worker pinning claim. Affinity expansion/restoration is outside every timer.
first_touch: Insert-only bitmaps constructed onCPU3 before expanding allowed affinity. Separate allocate+build trials start after expansion, so constructor may execute anywhere in the same-node allowed set. No durations are combined from separate intervals.
cpp_scheduler: Caller executes worker0; W-1 additional workers per pass; full native launches/joins included
rust_scheduler: For W>1, W scoped workers plus coordinating caller; extra caller shares the sameT physical-core budget. For W=1 direct serial fallback.
scratch: Public estimated explicit temporary build heap; language-specific metadata counted. No claim to measure allocator usable-size, runtime thread handles, OS stacks or RSS.
query_contract: One whole-array public native query call; proportional key partition, not the external shared4096-batch executor. Fresh-thread end-to-end only, no gated subtraction.
validation: Oracle bitmap destroyed before any timed builds; every trial checks all inserted keys and entire mixed output. Query bitmap allocated after build trials; every query trial checks all dense outputs/guards. Independent streamed calibration after timings.
quality: Ten family/geometry/size/seed records per language reused acrossT; no sample pooling acrossT or languages. Exact semantic parity required; confidence retained separately, no cross-language timing ranking.
scope: Initial60-row native public-API scaling screen; fixed seed42; no cross-language timing ranking
command_order: n ascending, capacity ascending, T ascending, then cpp/rust; source-derived shuffled filter rows
performance_authority: Separate explicit parent lease and reviewed source commit required
